corrections.text: The article lists as unknown "Whether any independent party has reproduced Moonshot's coding, finance or cyber figures" and says the sources reviewed did not report one. That holds for the cyber figures, but Artificial Analysis, which describes its evaluations as independently measured, includes Terminal-Bench 4.0 in its Intelligence Index and its model page data gives Kimi K3.1 Pro about 67.2% on that benchmark (Moonshot reports 65.7%), and The Decoder cites an Artificial Analysis GDPval-AA score of 1,846 Elo. These are independent measurements, not necessarily run under Moonshot's conditions.
